status: Numerical screening only; no prediction fitting or test outcomes used for selecting the grid/time step
forcing: Fixed ABC curl-eigenfield, seed 7788; identical within every cloned triplet
marker_interpolation: Periodic cubic B-spline interpolation in the same RK4 stages, one-way tracers; adopted after the retained trilinear marker-grid failure
prediction_design: After screening, lock grid/time steps and new disjoint train/validation/test seed lists before production. Primary target: integral 0..1.5 of perturbation energy divided by its impulse-time value; paired per-field forecast error across both strengths. Compare conventional global present measurements, stronger current flow/local/marker summaries, history augmentation, and whole-run shuffled histories. Frozen models, independent held-out fields, group bootstrap and multiplicity controls for the two regimes.
scope: Periodic constant-density 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes. Transient, initially random flows; turbulence characterization is measured, not assumed. No walls, molecular interactions, thermal phases, particle feedback, laboratory data, or fully developed high-Reynolds turbulence claim.
